[[File:Hibana.png|thumb|250px|Hibana]] '''Hibana''' (Japanese: '''ヒバナ''' ''Hibana'') is a recurring character in {{aniseries|JN}}. She is an {{tc|idol}}. She first appeared in ''[[JN007|Serving Up the Flute Cup!]]'', where she starred in a promotional spot for the [[Battle Frontier Flute Cup]], in which she presented the prize of the tournament: a set of all five [[flute]]s. She also invited {{pkmn|Trainer}}s to enter the competition. Hibana later awarded {{Ash}} his prizes at the award ceremony after he defeated [[Hodge]] in the final round. Hibana reappeared during a promotional video in ''[[JN038|Restore and Renew!]]'', where she presented a special exhibit of a {{pkmn2|giant}} {{p|Shieldon}} at the [[Pewter Museum of Science]]. ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{electric color light}}|bordercolor={{psychic color light}} |ja=足立梨花 ''[[Rika Adachi]]'' |en=[[Alyson Leigh Rosenfeld]] |fr_eu=Marie Braam |he=מייה קדוש ''Mia Kadosh'' ([[JN007]])
